# input: # The engine-free door, read end to end: `parseAmount` and then `formatAmount`
# over what it returned. Six columns because a currency parse has two halves
# that fail separately — the digits and the word — and one assertion could not
# tell "we do not know that currency" from "check your input".
# `mode` is `symbols: true` or the default. It is a column rather than two
# files because the interesting rows are the ones that differ across it: `$30`
# appears twice below and reads as thirty dollars only once. Off by default is
# deliberate — `evaluate("$30")` is the number 30, and a parser wider than the
# engine by default would make the two paths disagree about the same string.
# `-` is "no answer", not an empty string: a refusal has no currency, no amount
